text:
maria: Postmortem merged for last week's failover+cache storm. We need clear owners for runbook + playbook edits and a short remediation plan. Who volunteers?

jin: I'll take runbook triage steps. I'll add explicit commands and decision gates (when to fallback vs. when to run warmup).

sam: I'll own the automation and the smoke harness. Will add CI job to exercise the runbook steps in staging.

ops-bot: FYI: use runbook change template: https://redwood.internal/templates/runbook-change.md. Link postmortem ID in PR.

alex: Observed repeating chain: failover -> cache cold -> request pileup -> routing latency spike. Add a triage step to query eviction rate + pending queue depth. Query example: `curl -s "http://prometheus/api/v1/query?query=rate(cache_evictions_total[1m])" | jq -r .data.result[0].value[1]` then check `kubectl get hpa -n prod router -o jsonpath='{.status.currentCPUUtilizationPercentage}'`.

leo: Small style ask: include `--output=json` flags where possible and example `jq` filters so automation can parse results.

maria: Owners + rough SLAs: jin (triage doc + commands) by Tue EOD, sam (automation + test harness) by next Thu, alex (alerts & escalation chain) by next Fri, nina (runbook QA + docs lint) by Wed. Agree?

jin: Works for me. I'll include both Prometheus and `redis-cli INFO` checks in the triage. Example: `redis-cli -h cache-main INFO memory | grep used_memory_human` and a note: if used_memory drops > 30% concurrent with eviction spike, escalate.

sam: Draft smoke script I'll add to infra tests: 
```
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
# trigger controlled failover in staging
python tools/simulate_failover.py --target=staging || true
# run read-only traffic load
ab -n 300 -c 10 http://staging/api/health || true
# run runbook checks
curl -s "http://prometheus/api/v1/query?query=rate(cache_evictions_total[1m])" | jq -r .data.result[0].value[1] > /tmp/evict_rate
python tools/check_warmup.py --threshold 0.6 --output json
```

alex: For alerts: add composite alert: eviction_rate > 400/min AND router_cpu > 65% for 5m -> page primary oncall. Add failover paging SLA 10m for critical model endpoints. Also add a fallback routing step: `redwoodctl route update --service=generator --variant=m-quantized-compact --weight=1.0` as emergency action.

leo: Also suggest adding a short note to runbook about `redis warmup` best practices and a sample warmup command: `python scripts/redis_warm.py --pattern "session:*" --concurrency 10 --throttle 50 --dry-run --output json` and show an example parsed output.

maria: Can we include an ops checklist with: pre-checks, failover trigger, eviction check, warmup, scale workers, update routes, and post-checks? Add who to ping at each step.

jin: I'll add a decision table: if eviction_rate > 1000/min -> immediate fallback route + page; if 400-1000 -> start warmup + scale workers down to reduce concurrency; else follow warmup-only path.

sam: I'll add a `canary/runbook_drill.sh` job in CI that runs a dry-run of these commands and validates expected responses. Will add unit tests for `redis_warm.py` and `check_warmup.py`.

nina: I'll run a docs lint and ensure runbook passes our example validation (JSON output present, code blocks fenced, links resolvable). Also will add an assertion that all commands have `--output=json` variants where applicable.

ops-bot: Created task RW-PT-999 assigned: jin, sam, alex, nina, leo. Labels: postmortem-followup, runbook.

maria: Timeline: PRs by 2026-04-08, automation merged by 2026-04-15, schedule runbook drill week of 2026-04-20. I'll set calendar invites and a short review meeting.

alex: One more ops detail: add a temporary circuit-breaker step in routing to shed non-critical traffic during warmup: `redwoodctl throttle set --service=search --rate=500rps` and note rollback commands.

jin: PR opened for runbook edits: https://github.com/redwood/runbooks/pull/825. Contains triage checklist, decision table, and command snippets.

sam: Scripts PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra-scripts/pull/223 opened with `redis_warm.py`, `check_warmup.py`, and CI job.

maria: Thanks team. After merges, we'll run the canary drill and close the postmortem action items. Keep posting progress here. :white_check_mark:
